national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Multi-Agency Centre (MAC) under the Intelligence Bureau (IB) and Ministry of Home Affairs serves as the primary platform for multi-agency intelligence sharing and operational coordination across national security threats.
• Option A is Incorrect because NATGRID connects database servers of core security agencies rather than real-time operational intel fusion.
• Option C is Incorrect because CCTNS focuses on digitizing police station records and criminal tracking across states.
• Option D is Incorrect because CICC is not the official designated multi-agency security platform.

national_questions.qe: Which official portal of the Department of Youth Affairs serves as the implementation platform for the 'Khelo India Samvad' initiative launched to connect youth with national fitness goals?
national_questions.qh: राष्ट्रीय फिटनेस और खेल लक्ष्यों से युवाओं को जोड़ने के लिए शुरू की गई 'खेलो इंडिया संवाद' पहल के कार्यान्वयन मंच के रूप में युवा कार्यक्रम विभाग का कौन सा आधिकारिक पोर्टल कार्य करता है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the 'Khelo India Samvad – Khel Ki Baat PM Ke Saath' initiative is executed through the 'Mera Yuva Bharat' (MY Bharat) portal to engage youth in national sports objectives.
• Option B is Incorrect because Fit India Movement Portal focuses on general physical wellness and fitness pledges.
• Option C is Incorrect because there is no dedicated sports governance portal executing this youth dialogue.
• Option D is Incorrect because Viksit Bharat Yuva Portal is a general policy dialogue framework rather than the specific host platform for this scheme.

national_questions.qe: Which flagship initiative under the Atal Innovation Mission provides school-level hands-on innovation workspaces, with which Indian space startups were urged to collaborate to build scientific temper?
national_questions.qh: अटल नवाचार मिशन के तहत कौन सी प्रमुख पहल स्कूली स्तर पर व्यावहारिक नवाचार कार्यक्षेत्र प्रदान करती है, जिसके साथ भारतीय अंतरिक्ष स्टार्टअप्स को वैज्ञानिक दृष्टिकोण विकसित करने के लिए सहयोग करने का आग्रह किया गया था?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Atal Tinkering Labs (ATLs), established under NITI Aayog's Atal Innovation Mission in schools across India, serve as the primary grassroots framework to foster scientific curiosity and practical STEM skills.
• Option A is Incorrect because Atal Incubation Centres support higher-level startups at universities/institutions, not school-level labs.
• Option B is Incorrect because ACICs focus on underserved/unserved regions' community-driven innovation.
• Option D is Incorrect because ATLs is the official term, not Atal New Generation Labs.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian city was selected as the host venue for the prestigious BWF World Championships 2026 badminton tournament?
national_questions.qh: प्रतिष्ठित BWF विश्व चैंपियनशिप 2026 बैडमिंटन टूर्नामेंट के मेजबान शहर के रूप में किस भारतीय शहर को चुना गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because New Delhi was designated as the host city for the BWF World Championships 2026.
• Option A is Incorrect because Hyderabad, while a major badminton hub, was not the designated host city for this event.
• Option B is Incorrect because Bengaluru was not selected for this world championship edition.
• Option C is Incorrect because Mumbai did not host the BWF World Championships 2026.

national_questions.qe: Where has India's first public-private joint venture facility in the defence avionics sector been established by Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) and Samtel Avionics?
national_questions.qh: हिंदुस्तान एयरोनॉटिक्स लिमिटेड (HAL) और समटेल एवियोनिक्स द्वारा रक्षा एविओनिक्स क्षेत्र में भारत की पहली सार्वजनिक-निजी संयुक्त उद्यम सुविधा कहाँ स्थापित की गई है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because India’s first public-private defence avionics joint-venture facility (Samtel HAL Display Systems) was inaugurated at Udyog Vihar in Gurugram, Haryana, to produce multifunction displays for fighter aircraft like Su-30 MKI, ALH, and LCH.
• Option A is Incorrect because Bengaluru is the headquarters of HAL, but this specific joint venture manufacturing plant was opened in Gurugram.
• Option C is Incorrect because Hyderabad hosts various missile and defence electronics labs, not this specific avionics JV facility.
• Option D is Incorrect because Pune is home to several defence research establishments, but not this avionics plant.

national_questions.qe: Which award was conferred by the Committee on Space Research (COSPAR) and ISRO upon the first Indian woman scientist at the 46th COSPAR Scientific Assembly in Florence, Italy?
national_questions.qh: इटली के फ्लोरेंस में आयोजित 46वीं COSPAR वैज्ञानिक सभा में पहली भारतीय महिला वैज्ञानिक को COSPAR और ISRO द्वारा किस पदक से सम्मानित किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the COSPAR Vikram Sarabhai Medal, awarded jointly by COSPAR and ISRO for outstanding space research, was presented to the first Indian woman recipient at Florence, Italy.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Aryabhata Medal is awarded by the Astronautical Society of India for outstanding domestic contributions.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize is awarded annually by CSIR for multi-disciplinary scientific research within India.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Homi Bhabha National Award recognizes outstanding contributions primarily in the field of atomic energy.

national_questions.qe: In which state has India's first 21 cubic metre capacity electro-hydraulic face shovel been commissioned at South Eastern Coalfields Limited's (SECL) Gevra Mega Project?
national_questions.qh: साउथ ईस्टर्न कोलफील्ड्स लिमिटेड (SECL) की गेवरा मेगा परियोजना के तहत भारत का पहला 21 क्यूमेक क्षमता वाला इलेक्ट्रो-हाइड्रॉलिक फेस शोवेल (इलेक्ट्रिक फावड़ा) किस राज्य में चालू किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because India's first 21 CuM capacity electro-hydraulic face shovel was commissioned at SECL’s Gevra Mega Project located in Korba district, Chhattisgarh.
• Option A is Incorrect because coal mining in Jharkhand falls primarily under Bharat Coking Coal Limited (BCCL) and Central Coalfields Limited (CCL).
• Option B is Incorrect because Odisha coal mining operations are managed by Mahanadi Coalfields Limited (MCL).
• Option C is Incorrect because Madhya Pradesh operations are overseen by Northern Coalfields Limited (NCL), whereas Gevra is situated in Chhattisgarh.

national_questions.qe: In which year was the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) launched to drive national financial inclusion?
national_questions.qh: राष्ट्रीय वित्तीय समावेशन को बढ़ावा देने के लिए 'प्रधानमंत्री जन धन योजना' (PMJDY) की शुरुआत किस वर्ष की गई थी?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) was launched in August 2014 as the National Mission for Financial Inclusion. It has achieved over 59 crore accounts with total deposits exceeding ₹3.17 lakh crore.
• Option A is Incorrect: 2012 predates the announcement and rollout of PMJDY.
• Option C is Incorrect: 2016 was the launch year of Stand-Up India and UPI, not PMJDY.
• Option D is Incorrect: 2018 marked the launch of Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY).

national_questions.qe: The seasonal respiratory illness causing strain known as H1N1 belongs to which antigenic subtype category of influenza?
national_questions.qh: मौसमी श्वसन संबंधी बीमारी का कारण बनने वाला H1N1 स्ट्रेन किस इन्फ्लूएंजा वायरस श्रेणी का एक एंटीजेनिक सबटाइप है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because H1N1 is a subtype of Influenza A virus, commonly responsible for seasonal flu surges and historical pandemics like swine flu.
• Option A is Incorrect because Influenza B viruses do not have designated H/N subtypes and mostly infect humans without causing global pandemics.
• Option B is Incorrect because Influenza C viruses cause mild respiratory illness and are not divided into H/N subtypes.
• Option D is Incorrect because Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) belongs to the Pneumoviridae family, distinct from influenza viruses.

national_questions.qe: Which national laboratory network under ICMR and DHR is dedicated to pan-India surveillance and diagnostic monitoring of viral respiratory outbreaks?
national_questions.qh: ICMR और DHR के तहत कौन-सा राष्ट्रीय प्रयोगशाला नेटवर्क पूरे भारत में वायरल श्वसन प्रकोपों की निगरानी और नैदानिक ट्रैकिंग के लिए समर्पित है?
oe: Virus Research and Diagnostic Laboratories (VRDL) Network
National Vector Borne Disease Control Programme (NVBDCP)
oh: वायरस अनुसंधान एवं निदान प्रयोगशाला (VRDL) नेटवर्क
राष्ट्रीय वेक्टर जनित रोग नियंत्रण कार्यक्रम (NVBDCP)
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Virus Research and Diagnostic Laboratories (VRDL) network, run by ICMR and DHR across 73 laboratories, carries out viral disease surveillance and genomic tracking in India.
• Option A is Incorrect because IDSP is a broader disease surveillance program under the National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC).
• Option C is Incorrect because NVBDCP focuses specifically on vector-borne diseases like malaria, dengue, and kala-azar.
• Option D is Incorrect because CDSCO is India's national regulatory body for pharmaceuticals and medical devices.

national_questions.qe: Which statutory organization is responsible for creating, upgrading, maintaining, and managing civil aviation infrastructure across airports in India?
national_questions.qh: भारत के हवाई अड्डों पर नागरिक उड्डयन बुनियादी ढांचे के निर्माण, उन्नयन, रखरखाव और प्रबंधन के लिए कौन-सा सांविधिक संगठन जिम्मेदार है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the Airports Authority of India (AAI) is a statutory body under the Ministry of Civil Aviation responsible for creating, maintaining, and managing civil aviation infrastructure.
• Option A is Incorrect because DGCA is the regulatory body for safety and licensing in civil aviation.
• Option B is Incorrect because BCAS regulates aviation security standards.
• Option C is Incorrect because AERA regulates tariffs and other charges for aeronautical services at major airports.

national_questions.qe: Which special purpose vehicle (SPV) is tasked with executing India's first high-speed rail corridor connecting Mumbai and Ahmedabad?
national_questions.qh: मुंबई और अहमदाबाद को जोड़ने वाले भारत के पहले हाई-स्पीड रेल कॉरिडोर के कार्यान्वयन के लिए कौन सी विशेष प्रयोजन वाहन (SPV) एजेंसी जिम्मेदार है?
oe: National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited (NHSRCL)
oh: नेशनल हाई स्पीड रेल कॉर्पोरेशन लिमिटेड (NHSRCL)
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited (NHSRCL) is the Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) incorporated to execute the 508-km Mumbai-Ahmedabad High Speed Rail (MAHSR) project.
• Option B is Incorrect because IRCON International Limited is a general railway construction PSU under the Ministry of Railways.
• Option C is Incorrect because Rail Vikas Nigam Limited (RVNL) executes general rail infrastructure development projects.
• Option D is Incorrect because RITES Limited functions primarily as an engineering consultancy and advisory enterprise.

national_questions.qe: Who among the following was the first Indian skeet shooter to qualify for the Olympic Games and win an individual gold medal at the ISSF World Cup?
national_questions.qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन ओलंपिक खेलों के लिए क्वालिफाई करने और ISSF विश्व कप में व्यक्तिगत स्वर्ण पदक जीतने वाले पहले भारतीय स्कीट निशानेबाज बने?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Mairaj Ahmad Khan is the pioneer of Indian skeet shooting, becoming the first Indian in the discipline to represent the nation at the Olympics (Rio 2016, Tokyo 2020) and win an individual skeet gold medal at the ISSF World Cup (2022).
• Option A is Incorrect because Rajyavardhan Singh Rathore won an Olympic silver in the Double Trap discipline.
• Option C is Incorrect because Manavjit Singh Sandhu is a former World Champion in the Trap shooting discipline.
• Option D is Incorrect because Anantjeet Singh Naruka is a contemporary skeet shooter who won a bronze in mixed team skeet at Paris 2024.

national_questions.qe: In which city has India's first 14D technology-enabled virtual zoo been established under a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model?
national_questions.qh: सार्वजनिक-निजी भागीदारी (PPP) मॉडल के तहत भारत का पहला 14D तकनीक-संचालित वर्चुअल चिड़ियाघर किस शहर में स्थापित किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because India's first virtual zoo featuring 14D sensory effects was constructed in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, by the Indore Municipal Corporation on a PPP model.
• Option A is Incorrect because Ahmedabad houses Science City and conventional zoos, but not this 14D virtual zoo initiative.
• Option B is Incorrect because Surat municipal projects do not include this 14D virtual zoo landmark.
• Option D is Incorrect because Bhopal is the state capital of MP, whereas this specific civic project was set up in Indore.

national_questions.qe: In which country is the Catamarca province located, where Khanij Bidesh India Limited (KABIL) is conducting lithium exploration projects?
national_questions.qh: कैटामार्का प्रांत (Catamarca province) किस देश में स्थित है, जहां 'खनिज बिदेश इंडिया लिमिटेड' (KABIL) लिथियम अन्वेषण परियोजनाएं संचालित कर रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct: Khanij Bidesh India Limited (KABIL), a joint venture CPSE under the Ministry of Mines, is actively conducting lithium exploration and drilling operations in the Catamarca province of Argentina as part of India's strategic critical mineral security mission.
• Option A is Incorrect: Chile forms part of South America's 'Lithium Triangle', but KABIL's state-to-state lithium block acquisition and drilling projects are centered in Argentina.
• Option B is Incorrect: Bolivia possesses massive lithium salt flats (Salar de Uyuni), but the specific project site of KABIL is located in Argentina.
• Option D is Incorrect: Australia is a key hard-rock lithium supplier with bilateral critical mineral trade agreements with India, distinct from the Catamarca brine project.

national_questions.qe: Which Union Ministry formulates and regulates the Compressed Biogas (CBG) procurement pricing framework under the GOBARdhan initiative?
national_questions.qh: गोवर्धन (GOBARdhan) पहल के तहत कंप्रेस्ड बायोगैस (CBG) खरीद मूल्य निर्धारण ढांचे का निर्माण और नियमन कौन सा केंद्रीय मंत्रालय करता है?
oe: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct: The Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas (MoPNG) regulates the CBG procurement price structure, commercial off-take agreements, and integration into the domestic city gas distribution pool under the GOBARdhan initiative.
• Option B is Incorrect: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) provides financial assistance and Central Financial Assistance (CFA) schemes for bioenergy infrastructure, but does not set gas commercial pricing.
• Option C is Incorrect: The Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare oversees organic fertilizer standards (such as Fermented Organic Manure), but is not the pricing agency for gas.
• Option D is Incorrect: The Ministry of Jal Shakti serves as the overall nodal coordinating ministry for the unified GOBARdhan portal under Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen), while commercial energy integration falls under MoPNG.

national_questions.qe: 'DUSTLIK' is an annual joint military exercise conducted between the armed forces of India and which country?
national_questions.qh: 'दस्तलिक' (DUSTLIK) भारत और किस देश के सशस्त्र बलों के बीच आयोजित होने वाला एक वार्षिक संयुक्त सैन्य अभ्यास है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because 'DUSTLIK' is the flagship annual joint military exercise conducted between India and Uzbekistan to enhance counter-terrorism and defence cooperation.
• Option B is Incorrect because India conducts the joint military exercise 'KAZIND' with Kazakhstan.
• Option C is Incorrect because India conducts the joint special forces exercise 'KHANJAR' with Kyrgyzstan.
• Option D is Incorrect because India and Tajikistan maintain bilateral defence ties, but do not host 'DUSTLIK'.

national_questions.qe: The traditional harvest festival of 'Onam', characterized by floral carpets (Pookkalam) and snake boat races (Vallam Kali), is predominantly celebrated in which Indian state?
national_questions.qh: पुष्प रंगोली (पूक्कलम) और सर्प नौका दौड़ (वल्लमकली) के लिए प्रसिद्ध पारंपरिक फसल उत्सव 'ओणम' मुख्य रूप से किस भारतीय राज्य में मनाया जाता है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Onam is the premier harvest festival of Kerala, celebrated to mark the harvest season and welcome the mythical King Mahabali.
• Option A is Incorrect because the major harvest festival of Tamil Nadu is Pongal.
• Option C is Incorrect because Karnataka celebrates harvest festivals like Ugadi and Makara Sankranti.
• Option D is Incorrect because Andhra Pradesh celebrates Sankranti as its main harvest festival.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian shipyard constructed the country's first indigenously built multi‑purpose naval support vessel ‘Samarthak’?
national_questions.qh: भारत के पहले स्वदेशी निर्मित बहु‑उद्देश्यीय नौसैनिक सपोर्ट वैहिकल ‘समर्थक’ का निर्माण किस भारतीय शिपयार्ड ने किया?
oe: Larsen & Toubro (L&T) Shipbuilding at Kattupalli, Chennai
oh: लार्सन एंड टुब्रो (L&T) शिपबिल्डिंग, कत्तुपल्ली, चेन्नई
गार्डन रीच शिपबिल्डर्स एंड इंजीनियर्स, कोलकाता
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because ‘Samarthak’ was built by L&T Shipbuilding at its Kattupalli shipyard in Chennai, marking India’s first indigenously built multi‑purpose naval support vessel.
• Option B is Incorrect as Hindustan Shipyard builds other naval platforms but not ‘Samarthak’.
• Option C is Incorrect because Mazagon Dock focuses on warships and submarines, not this vessel.
• Option D is Incorrect as Garden Reach does not handle this project.

national_questions.qe: Under which ministry was India's first dedicated university for quantum computing and artificial intelligence established in Amaravati?
national_questions.qh: अमरावती में स्थापित भारत का पहला क्वांटम कंप्यूटिंग और कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता विश्वविद्यालय किस मंत्रालय के तहत स्थापित किया गया?
oe: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the university was set up by NIELIT under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY).
• Option A is Incorrect; the Science and Technology Ministry did not launch this university.
• Option C is Incorrect; the Ministry of Education is not the nodal agency for this initiative.
• Option D is Incorrect; the former HRD Ministry is unrelated to this project.

national_questions.qe: Which company began production of India's first liquid‑cooled power modules for EV chargers at its Hyderabad plant?
national_questions.qh: हैदराबाद में अपने प्लांट पर भारत के पहले लिक्विड‑कूल्ड पावर मॉड्यूल्स का उत्पादन किस कंपनी ने शुरू किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Exicom Tele‑Systems started manufacturing the liquid‑cooled AC and DC power modules for EV chargers at its Hyderabad facility.
• Option A is Incorrect; Tata Power does not produce these specific modules.
• Option B is Incorrect; Mahindra Electric focuses on EVs, not liquid‑cooled charger modules.
• Option D is Incorrect; Hyundai Motor India is an OEM, not a charger component manufacturer.

national_questions.qe: In which city was India's first 14‑metre acoustic‑transparent 4K LED cinema screen installed?
national_questions.qh: भारत की पहली 14‑मीटर ध्वनि‑पारदर्शी 4K LED सिनेमा स्क्रीन किस शहर में स्थापित की गई?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the 14‑metre acoustic‑transparent Direct View 4K HDR LED screen was installed at Magic Frames, Kakkanad, Kochi.
• Option A is Incorrect; Mumbai does not host this specific installation.
• Option B is Incorrect; Kolkata has no record of this screen.
• Option C is Incorrect; Chennai is not the location of the debut screen.

bihar_questions.qe: What was the total number of digital X‑ray machines deployed in Bihar's tuberculosis screening drive?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार में ट्यूबरकुलोसिस स्क्रीनिंग अभियान में उपयोग किए गए डिजिटल एक्स‑रे मशीनों की कुल संख्या क्या थी?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the State Health Society reported deployment of 491 digital X‑ray machines (including 140 AI‑powered handheld units) during the campaign.
• Option A is Incorrect because 321 machines were not mentioned in the report.
• Option B is Incorrect because 89 refers to the number of CBNAAT machines, not X‑ray units.
• Option C is Incorrect because 562 is the count of Truenat machines, not digital X‑ray machines.

bihar_questions.qe: Under which centrally sponsored scheme did the Union Government approve 11.18 lakh pucca houses for Bihar with an outlay of ₹13,427 crore?
bihar_questions.qh: कौन सी केंद्र सरकार की योजना के तहत केंद्र सरकार ने बिहार के लिए 11.18 लाख पक्के घरों को ₹13,427 करोड़ के बजट के साथ स्वीकृत किया?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the ₹13,427 crore housing package for 11.18 lakh pucca houses was approved under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana.
• Option B is Incorrect; PMGSY deals with rural road construction, not housing.
• Option C is Incorrect; PMKSY focuses on irrigation infrastructure.
• Option D is Incorrect; the Shram Yogi Maan‑Dhan scheme is a pension scheme for unorganised workers.

bihar_questions.qe: Which state recently became the first inland state in India to export value-added Tilapia fish products to the United States under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana?
bihar_questions.qh: हाल ही में 'प्रधानमंत्री मत्स्य संपदा योजना' के तहत संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका को मूल्य-वर्धित तिलापिया (Tilapia) मछली उत्पादों का निर्यात करने वाला भारत का पहला भू-आबद्ध राज्य कौन सा बना है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Chhattisgarh became the first landlocked (inland) state in India to export 382 tonnes of value-added Tilapia products to the USA under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY).

oh: यह स्वचालित रूप से नागरिकता समाप्त नहीं करता और न ही सामाजिक कल्याण लाभों से वंचित करता है।
इसके परिणामस्वरूप नागरिकता अधिनियम के तहत भारतीय नागरिकता स्वतः रद्द हो जाती है।
यह व्यक्ति को किसी भी सरकारी दस्तावेज या पासपोर्ट के लिए आवेदन करने से स्थायी रूप से वंचित करता है।
यह व्यक्ति को शिकायत निवारण के लिए अनुच्छेद 226 के तहत उच्च न्यायालय जाने के लिए अयोग्य बनाता है।
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Supreme Court clarified that exclusion from electoral rolls during Special Intensive Revision (SIR) is strictly an inquiry into voting eligibility by the Election Commission of India and does not automatically void citizenship or deny welfare rights.
• Option B is Incorrect because electoral revision by the ECI does not constitute a formal determination of citizenship under the Citizenship Act.
• Option C is Incorrect because citizens retain full rights to hold state domicile and apply for public welfare schemes.
• Option D is Incorrect because affected individuals maintain the constitutional right to seek judicial remedies before the High Court.

bihar_questions.qe: At which location in Nepal do the Sun Koshi, Arun Koshi, and Tamur Koshi rivers unite to form the Saptakoshi (Kosi) River before entering Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार में प्रवेश करने से पूर्व नेपाल में किस स्थान पर सुन कोशी, अरुण कोशी और तमूर कोशी नदियाँ मिलकर सप्तकोशी (कोशी) नदी का निर्माण करती हैं?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Kosi River (Saptakoshi) is formed by the confluence of three main mountain tributaries—Sun Koshi, Arun Koshi, and Tamur Koshi—at Triveni in Nepal before entering northern Bihar.
• Option A is Incorrect because Chatara in Nepal is where the river exits the gorge into the plains and carries nearly 100 million tonnes of annual silt.
• Option B is Incorrect because Rasuwa is a northern border district of Nepal known for glacial origin river systems.
• Option C is Incorrect because Barahachhatra is a Hindu pilgrimage site along the gorge of the Kosi River in Nepal.

bihar_questions.qe: Under which flagship initiative has the Bihar government planned to set up JEEViKA-Sudha sales centres across all 8,053 panchayats of the state?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार सरकार ने राज्य की सभी 8,053 पंचायतों में जीविका-सुधा बिक्री केंद्र स्थापित करने की योजना किस प्रमुख पहल के तहत बनाई है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because under the 'Saat Nischay-3' initiative, Bihar will establish JEEViKA-Sudha sales centres across all 8,053 panchayats to boost rural dairy businesses and foster women-led entrepreneurship.
• Option A is Incorrect because 'Har Khet Tak Sinchai Ka Paani' is a dedicated irrigation coverage scheme under Saat Nischay-2.
• Option B is Incorrect because Jal-Jeevan-Hariyali focuses on environmental preservation, tree plantation, and water body rejuvenation.

bihar_questions.qe: According to the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) report, which sector accounts for the largest number of ongoing central infrastructure projects valued at ₹150 crore and above?
bihar_questions.qh: सांख्यिकी और कार्यक्रम कार्यान्वयन मंत्रालय (MoSPI) की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, 150 करोड़ रुपये और उससे अधिक मूल्य की जारी केंद्रीय अवसंरचना परियोजनाओं की सर्वाधिक संख्या किस क्षेत्र में है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because according to MoSPI's report monitoring 1,775 mega infrastructure projects, the Transport & Logistics sector accounts for the highest number of projects (1,246), led by the Ministry of Road Transport & Highways with 993 projects.
• Option A is Incorrect because Power & Renewable Energy accounts for fewer mega projects in the MoSPI monitoring system.
• Option C is Incorrect because Petroleum & Natural Gas represents high expenditure values but a lower total count of monitored projects.
• Option D is Incorrect because Water Resources and Urban Infrastructure account for a small fraction of overall central mega projects.

bihar_questions.qe: Which river in Nepal experienced a sudden surge following a Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) near the Nepal-China border, prompting a flood alert along the Gandak River in Bihar and Uttar Pradesh?
bihar_questions.qh: नेपाल-चीन सीमा के समीप ग्लेशियर झील के फटने (GLOF) के कारण नेपाल की किस नदी में अचानक जलस्तर बढ़ गया, जिससे बिहार और उत्तर प्रदेश में गंडक नदी के किनारे बाढ़ का अलर्ट जारी किया गया?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct: A Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) near the Nepal-China border caused a sudden surge in Nepal's Trishuli River, which flows downstream into the Gandak River, triggering flood alerts across West Champaran and Muzaffarpur in Bihar and Kushinagar in UP.
• Option A is Incorrect: The Kosi River is another major transboundary river in eastern Bihar, but it was not involved in this specific Trishuli surge.
• Option B is Incorrect: Bagmati River flows through central Nepal and Bihar but forms a separate basin.
• Option D is Incorrect: Karnali River feeds into the Ghaghara system rather than the Trishuli-Gandak system.

bihar_questions.qe: What target emergency response time has been set for the 'Dial 112' service under the 'Police Didi' campaign launched in Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार में महिला पुलिसकर्मियों की गतिशीलता बढ़ाने हेतु शुरू किए गए 'पुलिस दीदी' अभियान के तहत 'डायल 112' सेवा का लक्षित आपातकालीन प्रतिक्रिया समय कितना निर्धारित किया गया है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct: Under the 'Police Didi' campaign, 2,700 scooties and 2,000 motorcycles were deployed for female police personnel in Bihar to lower the 'Dial 112' emergency response time to 5–7 minutes.
• Option B is Incorrect: 10–12 minutes is not the target response time specified under this campaign.
• Option C is Incorrect: 15–20 minutes represented previous average response times before the fleet enhancement.
• Option D is Incorrect: 25–30 minutes is significantly higher than the operational target.

bihar_questions.qe: Which of the following groups of districts in Bihar forms the core part of the Gandak River basin subject to seasonal flood vigilance?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार में निम्नलिखित में से जिलों का कौन-सा समूह मुख्य रूप से गंडक नदी बेसिन के अंतर्गत आता है जो मौसमी बाढ़ निगरानी के प्रति संवेदनशील है?
oe: West Champaran, East Champaran, Gopalganj, and Saran
oh: पश्चिम चंपारण, पूर्वी चंपारण, गोपालगंज और सारण

• Option B is Incorrect because Kishanganj, Araria, Purnea, and Katihar fall under the Mahananda and Kosi river basins in eastern Bihar.

• Option D is Incorrect because Gaya, Nawada, Aurangabad, and Jehanabad belong to the South Bihar plains drained by rivers like Falgu and Punpun.

bihar_questions.qe: In a judgment concerning candidate qualifications versus recruitment rules, the Supreme Court ruled against overqualified candidates while examining which specific state cadre rules?
bihar_questions.qh: सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने किस राज्य के कैडर नियमों की समीक्षा करते हुए यह फैसला सुनाया कि अधिक योग्यता वाले उम्मीदवार निर्धारित पात्रता मानदंडों को दरकिनार कर नियुक्ति का दावा नहीं कर सकते?
bihar_questions.e:

Narasimha and Alok Aradhe delivered this ruling in a dispute under the Bihar Lab Technician Cadre Rules, 2014, holding that candidates with higher qualifications (BMLT) cannot displace candidates holding prescribed lower qualifications (DMLT).
• Option B is Incorrect because the dispute originated in Bihar, not Uttar Pradesh.
• Option C is Incorrect because it does not relate to Rajasthan recruitment rules.
• Option D is Incorrect because the judgment was not based on Madhya Pradesh paramedical regulations.

bihar_questions.qe: Which state's operational framework has been adopted by the Bihar Government for the redevelopment of 31 BSRTC bus stands under the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार सरकार ने सार्वजनिक-निजी भागीदारी (PPP) मॉडल के तहत BSRTC के 31 बस अड्डों के पुनर्विकास के लिए किस राज्य के मॉडल को अपनाया है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Bihar approved the redevelopment of 31 Bihar State Road Transport Corporation (BSRTC) bus terminals under PPP mode by replicating Gujarat's GSRTC Bus Port model.
• Option A is Incorrect because Maharashtra's transport model was not chosen for this framework.
• Option C is Incorrect because Tamil Nadu's transit model was not adopted.

bihar_questions.qe: At which defence manufacturing facility was the foundation stone laid for a ₹472-crore project to overhaul T-72 and T-90 main battle tanks?
bihar_questions.qh: भारतीय सेना के T-72 और T-90 मुख्य युद्धक टैंकों के ओवरहाल हेतु 472 करोड़ रुपये की परियोजना की आधारशिला किस रक्षा निर्माण संयंत्र में रखी गई?

bihar_questions.qe: Under the Bihar Sugarcane Mechanisation Scheme, what is the maximum project funding cap provided to farmer groups for setting up agricultural machinery banks?

bihar_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because under the Bihar Sugarcane Mechanisation Scheme 2026-27, machinery banks established by farmer groups receive up to 80% project funding, capped at a maximum of Rs 8 lakh.
• Option A is Incorrect because Rs 5 lakh is below the designated maximum cap.
• Option B is Incorrect because Rs 6 lakh is not the correct statutory limit for machinery bank funding.
• Option C is Incorrect because Rs 7 lakh is not the defined upper limit under this scheme.

bihar_questions.qe: The Trishuli River, which recently witnessed a Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) near the Tibet border, is a major tributary of which river basin in Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: त्रिशूली नदी, जिसमें हाल ही में तिब्बत सीमा के पास हिमनद झील प्रस्फूटन बाढ़ (GLOF) की घटना देखी गई, बिहार की किस नदी प्रणाली की एक प्रमुख सहायक नदी है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct: The Trishuli River originates in Tibet and flows into Nepal to form the upper catchment of the Narayani River system, known as the Gandak River in India/Bihar. A GLOF event in the Trishuli River directly impacted downstream areas of the Gandak basin across northern Bihar.
• Option A is Incorrect: The Kosi River system consists of seven upper tributaries (including Arun, Sun Kosi, and Tamor) entering Bihar at Chatra.
• Option C is Incorrect: The Son River originates from the Amarkantak plateau in Madhya Pradesh and flows north-eastward into central Bihar.
• Option D is Incorrect: The Mahananda River originates in the Darjeeling hills of West Bengal and drains the eastern border districts of Bihar.

bihar_questions.qe: Which major river basin in Bihar was placed under flood alert across six districts including West Champaran and Gopalganj due to water surge originating from Nepal?
bihar_questions.qh: नेपाल में भारी बारिश के कारण पश्चिम चंपारण और गोपालगंज सहित बिहार के छह जिलों में किस प्रमुख नदी बेसिन में बाढ़ का अलर्ट जारी किया गया?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because flash floods in Nepal triggered rising water levels in the Gandak River basin, causing Bihar to alert six downstream districts: West Champaran, East Champaran, Gopalganj, Saran, Muzaffarpur, and Vaishali.
• Option A is Incorrect because Kosi affects the north-eastern districts like Supaul, Saharsa, and Madhepura.
• Option B is Incorrect because Bagmati affects Sitamarhi and Sheohar regions.
• Option D is Incorrect because Mahananda flows through Kishanganj and Purnia districts.
